description: This file defines the class ConceptSearchResult, which represents a search result for concepts in the OpenMRS system. It contains references to Concept and ConceptName objects, along with metadata such as the matched word and a transient weight.

classes.name: ConceptSearchResult
classes.description: Represents a search result in the concept search, holding the concept, concept name, matched word, and a weight.

methods.name: ConceptSearchResult
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a word, concept, and concept name.

methods.name: ConceptSearchResult
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a word, concept, concept name, and a transient weight.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with this search result.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept associated with this search result.

methods.name: getConceptName
methods.description: Returns the concept name associated with this search result.

methods.name: setConceptName
methods.description: Sets the concept name associated with this search result.

methods.name: getWord
methods.description: Returns the word matched in the search.

methods.name: setWord
methods.description: Sets the word matched in the search.

methods.name: getTransientWeight
methods.description: Returns the transient weight of this search result.

methods.name: setTransientWeight
methods.description: Sets the transient weight for this search result.
